title: Mercury, Intellect and Balance
sub: Complete notes on ASAP Ep. 5 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Mercury as the neuter planet of speech and trade, its mythology, its link to Venus and Rahu, and its remedies, with video timestamps.
desc: Complete notes on ASAP Ep. 5, Planet Mercury by Brajesh Gautam: the neuter planet of intellect, speech and trade, its mythology, house-by-house effects, its balance with Venus, and remedies, with video timestamps.
points: Mercury is a pipe, not a person.
It carries truth, lies, poison or nectar through your throat without judgment. What matters is only that the word lands clearly.
Not male, not female, not good, not bad. In the speaker's own framework this is why it has no fixed loyalty of its own.
Mercury and Rahu exalt each other.
Mercury does best in Rahu's house (Virgo), and Rahu does best in Mercury's house (Gemini).
Mercury earns, Venus enjoys. Tip too far either way and the other pan empties out.
Mercury governs teeth, nerves, joints and the small intestine.
A disturbed Mercury also shows up as paperwork trouble, stammering and muddled speech.
Mercury in the 6th or 12th house is a business warning.
The speaker calls this combination, in any sign, a reason to stay out of business, lending and speculation.
An emerald is Mercury's main gemstone.
Green cloth, whole green moong dal and caring for a goat or parrot are his everyday remedies, alongside alum for the evil eye.
puts: Jupiter (Brihaspati), king of the gods' teachers, is married to Tara.
